product_name: Vegan Clean-Label Plain Unsweetened Yogurt Alternative
product_brief: Develop a vegan clean-label plain unsweetened yogurt alternative containing at least 5% protein and at most 1% naturally occurring sugar. Requires clean neutral-tart profile, firm set curd, and 45-day shelf life. Strictly avoid dairy, gelatin, and artificial sweeteners.

process_steps: Stage 1: Rehydrate plant-dairy base and disperse protein isolates under high-shear mixing.
Stage 2: Hydrate hydrocolloid texturizers (pectin/starch) and pasteurize matrix (85-90°C for 5 minutes).
Stage 3: Cool to 42°C, inoculate bio-fermentation starter culture, and incubate to target pH 4.4 - 4.6.
Stage 4: Gentle break agitation, blend fruit/flavor preparation, and aseptic fill into chilled storage.
